title: The Map and the Fan
lines: A fan is at the mat.
The map is at the mat.
Fan it, Tim! Fan the map.
The map is in the pit!
Nan and Tim sit at the pit.

questions.ask: Where does the map end up?
questions.listenFor: In the pit. The fourth line says so.

questions.ask: Who is at the pit at the end?
questions.listenFor: Nan and Tim. The last line names them.

questions.ask: What do you think they will do next? Tell me.
questions.listenFor: Any idea. Getting the map back is the likely one, but anything they can explain is fine.
